_comment: Known Modrinth mislabels: mods marked server 'unsupported' upstream that are
in fact needed (or perfectly functional) on dedicated servers. Consulted at
Layer 1 precedence slot 2 (with the config allowlist) — a match always
installs. Matching: exact sha1, case-insensitive modId, or case-insensitive
filename prefix on the JAR basename.
flywheel/athena/chameleon: rendering/shared libraries that dedicated servers must still have
because Create/Chipped/Storage Drawers hard-require them (they no-op or share code server-side).
NotEnoughItems: Modrinth marks unsupported, but GTNH and many 1.7 packs hard-require it server-side.
ctm: Fabric marks environment=client, but Chipped and others hard-require it; server no-ops textures.
drinkbeer: crash-risk false positive; Create Astral kubejs scripts register its effects.
